label: Rulesets on every repo
means: Active org branch rulesets whose repository condition includes ~ALL.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, About rulesets (https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-rulesets/about-rulesets, read 2026-11-26): an org-wide ruleset applies to many repos at once; template goal: at least one
source: state: gh api orgs/<owner>/rulesets?targets=branch, then each active one in full: conditions.repository_name.include holds ~ALL

params.comment: owner: the GitHub org read; empty means the quality config's owner.

label: Default branch guarded on every repo
means: Whether a ruleset on every repo requires a pull request and blocks force push and deletion on the default branch.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, REST API endpoints for rules (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/orgs/rules, read 2026-11-26) names these rule types; template goal: all three on the default branch
source: state: the same rulesets: one on ~ALL repos and ~DEFAULT_BRANCH with rules pull_request, non_fast_forward and deletion

label: One read
means: Seconds this tab's collector takes to read the org's branch rulesets.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Best practices for using the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26), asks for serial requests; template goal: a few serial reads finish in seconds
source: wall time of this tab's collector, first request to last

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the org's branch rulesets spends.
goal_source: GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api, read 2026-11-26): GITHUB_TOKEN gets 1,000 requests per hour per repository; template goal: one read spends a hundredth of that
source: gh api requests this tab's collector made, one per page
